cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C5 alkyl-sulfate chassis - defining anionic Sodium Lauryl Sulfate@2 with at least two prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3, Coco-Betaine@14, Coco-Glucoside@15) and no reinforcing route. Counter-signal: only the betaine@3 is early; the other two buffers count as prominent only because Parfum is declared last (E3), and they sit after lecithin/NaOH, so strong is the realistic neighbor.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one cationic polymer (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@17) plus light routes - Glycerin@8, honey@5-6, weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate@9, Lecithin@12, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@16, pearlizer Glycol Distearate@10. No silicone and no payload lipid, so C2 is not met and high is not supported. Counter-signal: guar is mid-late and the SLS chassis is cleansing-led; low is the neighbor.

wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium Lauryl Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide-type thickener or pearlizing wax at 21-29

weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - one mid-list guar plus weak refatters
weightPotential.persistence: low - weak refatters and a single guar rinse readily
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate - SLS chassis with betaine/glucoside buffers (C5 moderate)
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families present (cationic_polymer, weak_refatter); because Parfum is last everything counts as prominent.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only light routes; an effective SLS chassis faces a single guar and weak refatters.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the second family is weak_refatter only (Glyceryl Oleate, Lecithin, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate, antioxidants), with humectants; there is no silicone, payload lipid or protein; the single guar@17 sits after NaOH and the co-surfactants, and the SLS-led reset offsets it.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar dose unknown; Parfum-last list weakens position reading.
weightPotential.rationale: Low: single light cationic + weak refatters vs. effective SLS reset (6.6, W2).
